scope: Real isolated auth, SQLite, quota, worker and exact PDF; explicitly named failures use browser transport doubles; all external requests blocked
checks: A real generation is published and its response is lost; Enter retries the identical in-memory key and DTO, skips profile PUT, replays exact JSON and leaves one historical plan
Generated-plan PDF uses the exact persisted plan ID with Bearer; real missing auth is 401 and another owner gets 404; valid Blob is initiated and later revoked
Explicit preparation of another DTO creates another key; real Free per-client quota rejects it and the historical count stays one
A rejected profile PUT is visible and no generation POST is sent
Named transport doubles cover pending/published/failed/missing/conflict/reconciliation plus HTTP 200 HTML and empty JSON; recovery never shows success or silently rotates the key
Malformed meal objects never leave partial success visible; transport-injected quantities and equivalents render as text without executing markup
An in-flight response after a cross-tab account/session change is discarded and the old operation cannot be retried
A valid PDF response arriving after a same-tab real account switch creates no Blob/download and discards the previous history rows
History downloads the row’s exact plan with Bearer; HTTP 200 HTML never creates a PDF and an invalid history payload shows a retryable error instead of an empty portfolio
